panels.description:
Source: ElasticSearch; Index: landing_auth_events*

Input: trackingNumber

Description: When monitoring a service interaction it's important to understand the list of every interaction b/w services and time taken for each one of them. This panel highlights the calls that's taking more time, violating the thresholds.

Green: [0 - 100]			
Yellow: [101 - 150]			
Red: [151 - 10000]
panels.title: timeTaken to all calls for $trackingNumber
